entries.jp:
龍馬　高杉　桂
土方　沖田
この五人の全てを
振り絞ったロックでも
entries.en:
Even the rock
that Ryoma,
Takasugi,
Katsura, Hijikata
and Okita poured
everything they
had into...

entries.jp:
三百年もの間
降り積もった
怨霊たちの
悲しみを溶かし
entries.en:
...could not melt
the sorrow of the
vengeful spirits
piled up over
three hundred
years,

entries.jp: その凝り固まった心を\n解放することは\n出来なかった
entries.en: nor set their\nhardened hearts\nfree.

entries.jp: 慶喜に乗り移った\n怨霊の勝利だった
entries.en:
It was a victory
for the vengeful
spirits that had
possessed
Yoshinobu.

entries.jp:
響かぬ……
そのような歌で
我らの悲しみ
癒せはせぬ！
entries.en:
It does not reach
us... A song like
that cannot heal
our sorrow!

entries.jp: 慶喜様\n今こそ　こやつらを\n虜にできます！
entries.en:
Yoshinobu-sama,
now you can make
these fools your
thralls!

entries.jp: 貴方様の夢が叶いますぞ！
entries.en: Your dream is\ncoming true, my\nlord!

entries.jp: そうだね　直弼\n坂本達を仲間に\nできるんだ！
entries.en:
That's right,
Naosuke. I can
make Sakamoto
and the others my
friends!

entries.jp: そんな　わしらの歌が\n届かない……っ
entries.en: No way... Our\nsong ain't reachin'\nhim...!

entries.jp: 聴くのだ！\n予の……徳川の歌を！
entries.en: Listen! To my... to\nthe Tokugawa\nsong!

entries.jp: そして予と一緒に歩もう\nこの泰平の世を……
entries.en: And walk with me\nthrough this\nworld of peace...

entries.jp: ダメだ！\n悲しみの波動が　声が……\n呑み込まれる！
entries.en:
No! The waves of
sorrow, the
voices... They're
swallowing us!

entries.jp: なんて　なんて……\n悲しい歌なんだ……
entries.en: What a... what a\nsad song this is...

entries.jp: 将軍様！\nやめるんだ\n……ぐぅっ！
entries.en: Lord Shogun!\nStop this... ngh!

entries.jp: ダメだよ……\n僕　この気持ちが\nわかっちゃうんだ……
entries.en: It's no use... I... I\nunderstand how\nhe feels...

entries.jp: 悲しみに……\nわしの魂が悲しみに\n呑み込まれていく！
entries.en: Sorrow... My soul's\nbein' swallowed\nup by sorrow!

entries.jp: さあ　歌おう\n予を受け止めて\nくれるんだろう？
entries.en: Now, let's sing.\nYou'll accept me,\nwon't you?

entries.jp: 共に行こう\n我らはひとつ
entries.en: Let us go\ntogether. We are\none.

entries.jp: 仲間になるんだ！\n天歌泰平の友として……！
entries.en:
You'll be my
friends! Friends
of Heaven's Song
Peace...!

entries.jp:
城内は静謐に満ちていた
そこには怒りも喜びも
人らしい感情を表す者は
いない……
entries.en:
The castle was
filled with
stillness. No one
there showed
anger, joy, or any
human feeling at
all...

entries.jp: ……これこそが\n予が望んでいた天歌泰平
entries.en:
...This is it.
Heaven's Song
Peace, just as I
wished.

entries.jp: 誰もが悲しまず\n苦しまず　差別もない
entries.en:
No one grieves,
no one suffers,
and no one is cast
aside.

entries.jp: 予は一人じゃない\nこれからも　ずっと
entries.en: I'm not alone. Not\nnow, not ever.

entries.jp: 重く暗い空気が立ちこめる中\n慶喜が無邪気に微笑んでいる
entries.en:
Amid the heavy,
dark air,
Yoshinobu smiled
innocently.

entries.jp: その背には徳川三百年の内に\n積もり積もった怨念が\n霊となって取り憑いていた
entries.en:
On his back clung
the grudges piled
up over three
hundred years of
Tokugawa rule,
turned into
spirits.

entries.jp: 否　慶喜そのものがすでに\nその怨霊と同化している
entries.en:
No--Yoshinobu
himself had
already become
one with those
vengeful spirits.

entries.jp: お前も\nそう思うだろう？\n坂本龍馬
entries.en: You think so too,\ndon't you, Ryoma\nSakamoto?

entries.jp: はっ　まっこと\nそのとおり
entries.en: Yes, my lord.\nTrue as can be.

entries.jp: 慶喜の声に龍馬が\n顔を上げる
entries.en: At Yoshinobu's\nvoice, Ryoma\nraised his head.

entries.jp:
だがその目にかつての輝きは
すでになく
どんよりと感情を失った
死人の目をしている
entries.en:
But the light that
once shone in his
eyes was gone.
They were the
dull, emotionless
eyes of a dead
man.

entries.jp: 我ら全てみな\nこの身と心を\n将軍様に捧げます
entries.en:
All of us, each
and every one,
devote body and
soul to the Lord
Shogun.

entries.jp: 全ては泰平の世の\nために……
entries.en: All for the sake of\na peaceful world...

entries.jp: 俺はこれを望んでいた\nきっと　近藤さんも\n喜んでくれる
entries.en:
This is what I
wanted.
Kondo-san would
surely be pleased
too.

entries.jp: ふふ　ず～っとず～っと\n一緒だよ\nみんなも将軍様も……
entries.en:
Hehe. We'll be
together forever
and ever... all of
us, and the Lord
Shogun too...

entries.jp: 誰もが龍馬と同じ目を\nしていた
entries.en: Everyone had the\nsame eyes as\nRyoma.

entries.jp: みな泰平化され　\nかつての情熱を\n奪われている
entries.en:
All of them had
been pacified,
robbed of the
passion they once
had.

entries.jp: それを見て　慶喜は再び\n満足げに笑った
entries.en:
Seeing this,
Yoshinobu smiled
in satisfaction
once more.

entries.jp: 直弼　直弼　見てよ直弼\n予はようやく手に入れたよ\n心の平穏を……
entries.en:
Naosuke,
Naosuke, look,
Naosuke! I have
finally found it...
peace of mind...

entries.jp: もう一人じゃない\n孤独じゃない\n怯えることなんてない
entries.en:
I'm not alone
anymore. I'm not
lonely. There's
nothing to be
afraid of.

entries.jp: 予は永遠の絆を\n手に入れたんだ！
entries.en: I have found a\nbond that lasts\nforever!

entries.jp: ねえ　直弼　お前も\n喜んでくれるだろう？
entries.en:
Say, Naosuke,
you're happy for
me too, aren't
you?

entries.jp: 慶喜は振り向いて\n自らと同化した怨霊に囁いた
entries.en:
Yoshinobu turned
and whispered to
the vengeful
spirits that had
merged with
him...

entries.jp: 歓喜の声を上げる怨霊の中\nただ一人悲しげな顔を\n浮かべるその男に
entries.en:
...to the one man
who, amid the
rejoicing spirits,
alone wore a
sorrowful face.

entries.jp: 慶喜様……\nおいたわしや
entries.en: Yoshinobu-sama...\nhow it pains me\nto see you so.

entries.jp:
だがその井伊の声は
慶喜に届くことはない
呪いに呑み込まれた将軍は
ほの暗い幸福に浸っていた
entries.en:
But Ii's voice
would never
reach Yoshinobu.
Swallowed by the
curse, the shogun
was steeped in a
dim, hollow
happiness.

entries.jp: ふふふっ　はははっっ！\nもう寂しくなんてないんだ！
entries.en: Hehehe... Hahaha!\nI'm not lonely\nanymore!

entries.jp: 予は幸せだよ……！
entries.en: I'm so happy...!

entries.jp: 慶喜様はすでに\n怨霊の力に取り込まれて\nしまった……
entries.en:
Yoshinobu-sama
has already been
consumed by the
power of the
vengeful spirits...

entries.jp: どうして……どうして\nこのようなことに\nなってしまったのか……！
entries.en: Why... why did it\nhave to come to\nthis...!

entries.jp: 私はただ　あなたを……\n慶喜様を孤独の淵より\nお救いし　お守りしたかった
entries.en:
All I wanted was
to... to save you,
Yoshinobu-sama,
from the depths
of loneliness, and
to protect you.

entries.jp: だが……慶喜様は\nもはや……
entries.en: But...\nYoshinobu-sama\nis no longer...

entries.jp: 実体をもたぬ井伊の\n目から涙が零れ落ちる
entries.en:
Tears spilled
from the eyes of
Ii, who no longer
had a body of his
own.

entries.jp: 直弼？　ん？　直弼？\nどこだ？　直弼
entries.en: Naosuke? Hm?\nNaosuke? Where\nare you, Naosuke?

entries.jp: ここに……\nおそばにおりますよ\n慶喜様……
entries.en: Here... I am right\nby your side,\nYoshinobu-sama...

entries.jp: けれど\n慶喜が不安を見せれば\n優しく頬をすり寄せた
entries.en:
Yet whenever
Yoshinobu grew
uneasy, Ii gently
nestled his cheek
against him.

entries.jp: そこにおったか！\nふふ　そうじゃな　直弼は\n予を置いてはいかぬ！
entries.en:
There you are!
Hehe, of course.
Naosuke would
never leave me
behind!

entries.jp: ずぅっとずぅっと\n一緒じゃ……
entries.en: Together forever\nand ever...

entries.jp: 夢幻の世界にその心を\n囚われた悲しき主を\n直弼は優しく抱きしめた
entries.en:
Naosuke gently
embraced his
sorrowful lord,
whose heart was
held captive in a
world of dreams.

entries.jp: ああ　それでも　確かに\nこれで良かったのかも\nしれません……
entries.en: Ah... and yet,\nperhaps this truly\nwas for the best...

entries.jp: ええ　これで……
entries.en: Yes... like this...

entries.jp: 永久に慶喜の側に\nいられることを\n井伊直弼は喜ぶしかない
entries.en:
To remain at
Yoshinobu's side
for all eternity...
Naosuke Ii could
do nothing but
rejoice in it.

entries.jp: 二条城に響くのは\nただ　慶喜の狂った\n笑い声だけ……
entries.en:
All that echoed
through Nijo
Castle was
Yoshinobu's mad
laughter...

entries.jp: ＢＡＤ ＥＮＤ
entries.en: BAD END
